description: Create a new survey titled 'Q4 Employee Engagement'. You need to import the employee roster from '/home/ga/Documents/employee_roster.csv' into the survey participant table. During import, you MUST map the CSV columns to the participant attributes as follows: 'department' to Attribute_1, 'location' to Attribute_2, and 'manager_name' to Attribute_3. Finally, add a Text Display question to the survey with the text: 'Our records show you are in the {TOKEN:ATTRIBUTE_1} department.' (using the correct attribute placeholder syntax to pipe the department name).
